",
  "instructions": "仅合成数据，不是公司结论；人民币元，净收入/净销售额=订单实付减已记录退款， 不等于财务确认收入或毛利。订单日期为 Asia/Shanghai 业务 DATE，区间起含止不含， 退款归属原订单日。sales_orders 每行一订单，order_id 全局唯一； 客户身份必须使用 dept_id 和 customer_id。未匹配维度不丢订单。
sales_refunds 必须先按 dept_id、order_id 汇总退款，再 LEFT JOIN sales_orders。 无退款为零，计算一行一订单 paid_amount-COALESCE(refund_total,0)。 不关联 sales_order_lines 累计实付；不使用财务确认表替代净收入。
当前行业来自 crm_customers，按 dept_id、customer_id 与基础订单关联； 缺失客户保留订单，行业为“未知行业”。历史订单按当前客户归属重新分组。",

arguments.sql:
WITH refund_totals AS (
  SELECT dept_id, order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_total
  FROM sales_refunds
  GROUP BY dept_id, order_id
), base_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.dept_id, o.customer_id,
         o.paid_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_total, 0) AS net_amount
  FROM sales_orders o
  LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON o.dept_id = r.dept_id AND o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
), industry_groups AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.industry, '未知行业') AS label, SUM(b.net_amount) AS amount
  FROM base_orders b
  LEFT JOIN crm_customers c ON b.dept_id = c.dept_id AND b.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(c.industry, '未知行业')
)
SELECT 'group' AS row_type, label, amount FROM industry_groups
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total' AS row_type, '不重复总额' AS label, SUM(net_amount) AS amount FROM base_orders
